content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert - PDR-3012 fired for service=rate-limiter. Symptoms: sudden 429 surge across multiple routes, starting ~18:12 UTC. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/rate-limiter-spike. PagerDuty incident: https://pagerduty/redwood/PDR-3012

michael: ack @channel, I'm the oncall. pulling logs and checking metrics now. tagging @elena and @raj.

michael: quick sanity check - top 5 callers returning 429s look tenant-scoped. sample curl showing 429 payload:
```
curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' -d '{"input":"hello"}'
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"quota_exceeded", "code":429, "details":{"tenant_id":"acme-corp","quota_id":"tkn_000"}}
```

elena: looking at the quota-mapper logs - I see mapping failures for requests with X-Quota-Tag header present. Example log line: `WARN mapper: unmatched tag "" for request_id=...` seems like a regex change in last deploy matched nothing and set quota to 0. commit: git/commit/abcdef1234

raj: checking limiter pods in prod: `kubectl get pods -n prod | grep rate-limiter` shows one replica in CrashLoopBackOff (rate-limiter-0) and others healthy. logs from rate-limiter-0 show repeated panic in tag-parsing code, stacktrace referencing mapper v2.1.9.

raj: paging note - autoscaler didn't spin up new pods because crashloop prevented readiness probes. temporary mitigation: scale down to 0 that bad revision and scale up previous revision.

michael: applying temporary mitigation now - switching enforcement to "warn" for the affected tenant so calls are allowed but logged. command: 
```
redwoodctl quotas update --tenant acme-corp --enforcement warn --reason "mitigate PD-3012 while fixing mapper"
```

pagerduty: Incident PDR-3012 acknowledged by michael. Escalation profile: SEV2 (oncall -> engineering -> eng-sre).

support-bot: Customer impact summary: initial estimate ~2% traffic for acme-corp received 429 between 18:12-18:30 UTC. Reported by customer via support ticket #SUP-998. High-touch account flagged.

elena: confirmed root cause: the quota-mapper regex introduced in deployment `release/mapper@v2.1.9` treats missing tag as empty string which causes a fallback to an explicit quota=0 entry (regression). I have a one-line patch to treat empty as "default" and keep previous matching semantics. diff snippet: 
```diff
- matched = re.match(r"^quota:(.*)$", header)
+ matched = re.match(r"^quota:(.+)$", header)  # require non-empty
```

raj: preparing rollout of patched mapper image and restarting limiter deployment. steps below:
- kubectl set image deployment/mapper mapper=ghcr.io/redwood/mapper:patch-2026-03-15 -n prod
- kubectl rollout restart deployment/rate-limiter -n prod

michael: done: applied warn mode and started mapper patch rollout. monitoring 429 rate in dashboards.

raj: rollout status: mapper rollout complete, limiter restart finished. observed readiness ok. sample pod logs from new mapper show no tag parse warnings.

michael: metrics update - 429s for affected routes dropped from 18% -> 0.6% within 90s of mitigation. Graph link: https://dashboards/redwood/graphs/PD-3012-429s

elena: creating followup tasks:
- POSTMORTEM: assign elena, michael; due EOD tomorrow.
- HOTFIX PR merged: gh/PR/4321 (mapper fix)
- RFC: decide safer regex tests + add integration test for empty headers.

tina: heads-up to CS: please update acme-corp with mitigation steps and apology. cc @support-bot for ticket update.

support-bot: Updated ticket #SUP-998: mitigation applied, 429s resolved, awaiting customer confirmation.

michael: switching incident to monitoring state. leaving PD on-call ack until postmortem is filed.

elena: quick note for postmortem - we should add a canary test that sends requests without X-Quota-Tag to staging on every mapper build. also add alert when mapping errors spike > 1/min.

raj: action item: re-enable strict enforcement only after two hours of stable traffic and postmortem review. I will handoff to SRE rotation for monitoring.

michael: thanks everyone. closing notes: root cause = tag-regex regression in mapper release -> produced quota=0 fallback -> caused unexpected throttling for acme-corp. Mitigations = revert/patch mapper, set enforcement=warn for tenant, restart limiter. Followups created.

elena: :thumbsup: good catch.

michael: closing incident PDR-3012 in PD and will link postmortem when ready.

pagerduty: Incident PDR-3012 resolved and closed by michael.

michael: final — please add any missing notes here if you remember them.
